svg.text: World happiness vs GDP per capita (2005-2023, World Happiness Report + World Bank)

Rendered from results/tables (SQL on DuckDB, full data: 2,363 country-years, 165 countries). Life ladder = Gallup Cantril ladder 0-10; GDP per capita = World Bank GDP (current US$) / population; 'latest' = 2021-23 average.
